name: BMW M5 CS
description: The BMW M5 CS is a high-performance luxury sedan engineered to deliver supercar-level performance with everyday practicality. It combines aggressive M design, extreme power, precision handling, and advanced technology in one iconic package.
introduction: Meet the BMW M5 CS, the most powerful production M5 of its generation, built for drivers who demand uncompromising performance without giving up luxury.

specifications.drivetrain: M xDrive all-wheel drive with 2WD mode

features: M xDrive intelligent all-wheel-drive system with selectable 2WD mode
M-specific adaptive suspension tuned for high-performance driving
Carbon-fiber reinforced components for reduced weight
M Carbon ceramic brakes for exceptional stopping power
Aggressive M-specific exterior design with carbon-fiber details
M Carbon bucket seats with illuminated M5 CS logos
BMW Live Cockpit Professional with advanced digital displays
Premium interior combining Alcantara, leather, and carbon-fiber trim
Launch Control and advanced M performance driving modes

design.exterior: Aggressive, aerodynamic, and unmistakably BMW M, featuring carbon-fiber elements, distinctive kidney grilles, quad exhausts, and performance-focused detailing.
design.interior: A driver-focused cabin combining luxury materials with lightweight M Carbon seats, Alcantara surfaces, carbon-fiber trim, and signature M accents.

performance: With 635 hp, 750 Nm of torque, and a 0-100 km/h time of just 3.0 seconds, the M5 CS delivers breathtaking acceleration while retaining the comfort and practicality of a luxury sedan.
target_audience: Performance enthusiasts, BMW M fans, luxury car enthusiasts, and drivers seeking an uncompromising blend of everyday usability and track-inspired performance.
call_to_action: Experience the BMW M5 CS: where luxury meets M performance.
